:::: course-main
## About this course

Know some R but your projects are a tangle of scripts? This course teaches you the tools and habits that professional R developers use every day, so your work becomes clean, version-controlled and reproducible.

You'll start by setting up RStudio for efficient work: projects, essential shortcuts and the tidyverse style guide. Then you'll master **version control with Git and GitHub**, from configuring authentication to branching, undoing changes and collaborating with others.

Next comes **functional programming**: writing functions from basic to advanced, tidy evaluation and iteration with `purrr`. You'll apply everything to a real-world project, refactoring it into a modular, function-based pipeline. Finally, you'll make it reproducible with `renv`, so it runs the same on any machine.

::: course-video
{{< video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gc3PFF51Z7w aspect-ratio="16x9" >}}
:::

## What you'll learn

```{r}
course_checklist(c(
  "Configure RStudio and use projects, shortcuts and workflow tips",
  "Write clean, readable code following the tidyverse style guide",
  "Set up Git and GitHub, including authentication with 2FA and tokens",
  "Use the Git workflow: commit, push, pull, branches and undoing changes",
  "Collaborate with others through GitHub",
  "Write functions from basic to advanced, with tidy evaluation",
  "Iterate with `purrr` and refactor a real project into reusable functions",
  "Create reproducible environments with `renv` and portable projects"
))
```

## Who this course is for

```{r}
course_checklist(c(
  "R users who want to move from scripts to professional, maintainable projects",
  "Researchers who need reproducible analyses they can share and publish",
  "Data analysts who want to collaborate with Git and GitHub",
  "Anyone who wants to write cleaner, more efficient R code"
), columns = 1)
```

## Requirements

```{r}
course_checklist(c(
  "Basic to intermediate knowledge of R"
), columns = 1)
```

## Course contents

```{r}
course_data <- list(
  list(
    title = "Unit 1 - Course Introduction",
    topics = c(
      "Course overview and objectives",
      "Installing and configuring RStudio",
      "How to access and use course materials"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 2 - RStudio and Good Practices",
    topics = c(
      "Optimizing your RStudio setup",
      "Working with RStudio Projects",
      "Essential shortcuts and workflow tips",
      "Writing clean and readable R code",
      "Adopting the tidyverse style guide"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 3a - Version Control with Git and GitHub (Configuration)",
    topics = c(
      "Installing Git and connecting with GitHub",
      "Authenticating with GitHub (2FA and tokens)",
      "Configuring Git for your local projects"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 3b - Version Control with Git and GitHub (Workflows)",
    topics = c(
      "Creating and cloning repositories",
      "Understanding repository privacy",
      "Standard Git workflow (commit, push, pull)",
      "Undoing changes: reset, revert, restore",
      "Branching strategies and collaboration",
      "Working with others using GitHub"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 4 - Building a Real Project",
    topics = c(
      "Applying Git, RStudio, and coding practices in a real-world scenario",
      "Creating a reproducible and collaborative R project"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 5a - Functional Programming (Theory)",
    topics = c(
      "Principles of functional programming in R",
      "Writing functions: from basic to advanced",
      "Introduction to tidy evaluation",
      "Using iteration with `purrr`"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 5b - Functional Programming (Practice)",
    topics = c(
      "Refactoring the real-world project using functions",
      "Implementing modular and reusable code"
    )
  ),
  list(
    title = "Unit 6 - Reproducible Environments",
    topics = c(
      "Understanding packages, libraries, and repositories",
      "Creating reproducible setups using `renv`",
      "Managing R versions and environments",
      "Best practices for project portability and consistency"
    )
  )
)

course_curriculum(course, course_data)
```
